feeds.title: Wachler & Associates Health Law Blog
feeds.description: Wachler & Associates P.C. was founded in 1985. For over 25 years, our firm has represented healthcare providers nationwide in a wide variety of health law matters. We pride ourselves on combining our knowledge of health law with innovative and creative strategies to reach solutions for our clients. We have achieved many successful outcomes for clients throughout the years in several areas.

feeds.title: Michigan Health and Wellness Center Blog
feeds.description: At Michigan Health and Wellness, our mission is to educate our patients and website visitors with articles that can really help them live better, longer, and healthier lives. Scroll through our blog to see more articles and information about how Michigan Health & Wellness can serve you!

feeds.title: Communicare Michigan Blog
feeds.description: Since 1998, Communicare Michigan has been the gateway that allows clients to access their highest potential in their healing process. We continue to be at the forefront of leading-edge expertise, devoted care, and post-traumatic success. We are dedicated to providing brain injury survivors and other individuals with neurological impairments skills and support necessary to attain their highest level of functioning and quality of life.

feeds.title: Blog
feeds.description: The Michigan Association of Health Plans is a nonprofit corporation established to promote the interests of member health plans. The mission of the Michigan Association of Health Plans (MAHP) is to provide leadership for the promotion and advocacy of high-quality, affordable, accessible health care for the citizens of Michigan.

feeds.title: Michigan Health Endowment Fund Blog
feeds.description: The Michigan Health Endowment Fund is a philanthropic foundation that works to improve the health and wellness of Michigan residents while reducing healthcare costs. Our mission is to improve the health of Michigan residents, with special emphasis on the health and wellness of children and seniors, while reducing the cost of health care.

feeds.title: Michigan Healthcare Freedom Blog
feeds.description: Michigan Healthcare Freedom has been bridging the barriers with education and advocacy since 2012. We grow the local and state conversation about real-life problems and common-sense solutions, enabling people to advocate knowledgeably. Our blog is a medium to communicate that and we also write informative articles,

feeds.title: Compassionate Care Blog
feeds.description: Our name says it all. We're proud to provide residents of Michigan's Lower Peninsula with the compassionate care they need, where ever they call home. Learn more about which home care services we provide for your loved ones. And, we care for our staff with that same level of compassion and empathy.

feeds.title: Michigan Value Collaborative Blog
feeds.description: The goal of the Michigan Value Collaborative (MVC) is to improve the health of Michigan through sustainable, high-value healthcare. It is a partnership between Michigan hospitals, physician organizations, and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan/Blue Care Network. The program improves healthcare quality across Michigan through rigorous performance feedback, empirical identification of best practices, and collaborative learning.

feeds.title: #NAME?
feeds.description: The mission of the Wellness Institute of Michigan is our endless commitment to the highest quality of patient care provided by expertly trained professional clinicians. Quality care is about delivering our services with welcoming compassion, in a safe and non-judgmental environment. We promote the importance, normalization, acceptance, and understanding of mental health care for all people. We prevent the rise of mental health issues through quality care, education, and advocacy.

feeds.title: Michigan Tech
feeds.description: Michigan Technological University prepares students to create the future. Our mission to create a just, prosperous and sustainable world is expressed through our entrepreneurial spirit-equal parts curiosity, and grit. We work across disciplines to investigate dark matter, cloud droplets, gamma rays, industrial archaeological sites, and quantum mechanics.

feeds.title: MICHUHCAN Blog
feeds.description: Michigan Universal Health Care Access Network (MICHUHCAN) is a state-wide network that promotes comprehensive health care for all and improved health outcomes by addressing the social determinants of health through education, strategy development, and advocacy. We educate the public about how health care policy affects them and engage them to take action.

feeds.title: Life Skills Village Blog
feeds.description: We are an outpatient rehabilitation and mental health facility. Psychologists, social workers, occupational therapists, counselors, and speech-language pathologists all work collaboratively to help support our clients in progressing toward their goals. Our team will work with you in person, in the community, or online.

feeds.title: AmeriCare Medical
feeds.description: For over three decades, AmeriCare Medical, Inc. has provided integrated health services to hospitals, insurance companies, assisted care facilities, and private homes throughout Michigan. It is the only home healthcare organization in Michigan in which all services are nationally recognized and accredited by the Community Health Accreditation Program

feeds.title: A Healthier Michigan
feeds.description: Our mission is to help everyone in Michigan get healthier from the inside out. This means everything from giving you resources to help you make better decisions about diet and exercise, as well as information on creating and sustaining nurturing communities and successful businesses - everything you need to help create a healthier Michigan. Blog topics include healthy lifestyle, community, business, health reform, seniors, and events.
